prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync progress across all your desktop devices.", "Using the same account restores existing pets without losing data."]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "Click and drag to move your pet, right-click to open actions, or double-click to start chatting.", "Drag to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk", "Got It!"]
2: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "See how your pet will look and move right on your screen before adopting.", "Select breed and color"]
3: ["Your Pet is Preparing Its Desktop Home...", "We are generating high-res animations and configuring screen overlays.", "Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to summon your pet instantly."]
4: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to automatically restore your pet and stats."]
5: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "Please keep this window open while we finish rendering your pet."]
6: ["Upload a Clear Photo for Best Pet Results", "Use a well-lit photo with a single subject facing forward for best 3D pet generation results.", "Avoid blurry images, extreme angles, or crowded backgrounds."]
7: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Pick a quick preset for instant fun or customize from scratch. Both come with free starter items!", "Includes Free Starter Pack", "Preset Pet (Instant) vs Custom Creation"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop to meet your new friend, or click below to test summoning.", "Meet My Pet Now", "Test Desktop Call"]
9: ["You will receive a system notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency by telling users to sign in now to lock in their pet choice.
Mentions free extras and starter packs.
